basic_info.description: 571 36th Ave is a well-maintained 4 unit apartment building located in the Outer Richmond district, one of the most highly sought after neighborhoods in San Francisco. Constructed in 1960, this property consists of 4 one bedroom/one bath apartment units with great natural light and outlooks. There is a single garage plus three additional parking spaces in the rear. All the units are separately metered for gas and electricity. Tenants pay for their own heat. Excellent purchase opportunity for investors and owner occupier buyers alike. Vacant unit and private garage perfect for owner/occupier buyer!
